chunks: Abu Ayyub narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, in the Book of Ali عليه السلام it is stated that he would strike with the whip, with half the whip, and with part of it—that is, in the prescribed punishments—when a boy or a girl who had not yet reached maturity was brought, and he would not nullify any punishment from the punishments of Allah.

So he was asked: How would he strike with part of it? He said: He would take the whip in his hand from its middle and strike with it, or from one-third of it and strike with it, according to their ages. In this way he would strike them with the whip and would not nullify any punishment from the punishments of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.السَّوْطِ: The whip used in corporal legal punishment
key_terms.الْحُدُودِ: The prescribed legal punishments set by Allah
key_terms.بِبَعْضِهِ: Part of the whip, used to lessen the force of the punishment
key_terms.غُلَامٍ أَوْ جَارِيَةٍ: A boy or girl brought for disciplinary legal punishment
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: The recorded legal judgments and teachings attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.لَمْ يُدْرِكَا: They had not yet reached maturity
key_terms.نِصْفِ السَّوْطِ: Half of the whip, indicating a reduced form of striking

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali عليه السلام apply hudud punishments to boys and girls who had not reached maturity?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how Imam Ali عليه السلام applied legal punishments to minors in a reduced and proportionate manner without suspending Allah’s prescribed limits. It emphasizes calibrated implementation of hudud according to age and physical capacity while maintaining the authority of divine law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5148 - Abu Ayyub narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"In the book of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), it is mentioned that He (as) would administer punishment using a whip, half a whip, or even a part of it - meaning in the legal punishments (hudud) when a young boy or girl, who had not yet reached maturity, was brought to him.
Yet, He (as) would not nullify any of Allah's (swt) prescribed punishments."

Imam Al Sadiq (as) was asked: "How would he strike with part of the whip?"
Imam (as) replied: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) would hold the whip by its middle and strike with it, or he would hold it by a third and strike with it, in proportion to their ages.
In this way, he would strike them with the whip without nullifying any of Allah's (swt) prescribed punishments, the Mighty and Majestic."
